name: smwmusic-pok-mon-mystery-dungeon-gates-to-infinity-infinite-dungeon
title: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Gates to Infinity - Infinite Dungeon 3
description:
An all-around cheery theme that sounds good for an athletic level. Best used for a beach or sky level. It can work in a cave or water level if the aesthetics fit with the "cheery" feel from the song.

(EDIT: Octave and volume of the flute in the last portion of the song was raised and lowered respectively. Added a pitch bend to it as well. Removed some overlooked @25's.)
